With alpha = log2 3 and m_n = floor(n alpha), the sandwich (1/n) C(m_n - 1, n - 1) <= a(n) <= (1/n) C(m_n, n - 1), equality below exactly when frac(n alpha) is a strict record minimum and above exactly when it is a strict record maximum -- the equality orders being the one-sided convergent and semiconvergent denominators of log2 3, and a(n) a rational Catalan number. His a(n) is A100982, which is the laboratory's minimal certificate count M_d = 2 N_(d-1) - N_d. Checked against our own counts: the head matches, lower equality at n = 2, 7, 12, 53, 359, 665 and upper at n = 3, 5, 17, 29, 41, 94, 147, 200, 253, 306, 971, 1636. THE RESULT IS HIS AND THE CHECK IS OURS. Do not conflate his records with the empty-window theorem: his are a statement about ORDERS r, ours an existence statement about LENGTHS d.
